source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 30 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Natalie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ής Μαΐου — «Άγιος Νατάλιος ο Μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him. The whole life is one sentence and adds one fact to the folder: the manner of his death, «Ο Άγιος Μάρτυς Νατάλιος μαρτύρησε διά ξίφους», by the sword. It gives no year, no place and no century, so the folder still has no `dates`. No hymn is printed for him, only the distich «Xορού γενέσθαι Mαρτύρων διά ξίφους, Tον Nατάλιον μαρτυρούσιν αι βίβλοι», which is a couplet and not a service. The corpus's Anatoliuses, which the name sweep proposes, are other men on other days.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
